build_dataset_builder: build a Gigaword summarization dataset builder with train, validation, and test splits from downloaded org_data
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with document and summary text features and supervised keys for the Gigaword builder
generate_examples: generate examples from source and target text files, replacing <unk> tokens with UNK for train and validation splits
split_generators: split generators that download and extract the Gigaword dataset and configure train, validation, and test split paths
review_gigaword_class: review the Gigaword class that extends GeneratorBasedBuilder for headline-generation summarization dataset
